# Validation Steps for version: 
Before you go live with your release, ensure you do the following steps:

- [ ] Deploy the version branch to staging
- [ ] Ensure it deploys correctly

## Viewing existing articles
To ensure that the database didn't get messed up in the deployment, look at the existing articles
- [ ] Ensure the text of an article is fine
- [ ] Ensure the images in an article is fine
- [ ] Ensure a previous liveblog is fine

## Create a new article
- [ ] From the superadmin page, create a new Author
- [ ] Create a new standard article
- [ ] Upload a featured image
- [ ] Add the article's content: at least two richtext blocks and an image
- [ ] Publish the article

## Create a liveblog
- [ ] Create a liveblog
- [ ] Ensure from another monitor that it updates as you add liveblog updates
- [ ] Edit a previous update to add a photo

## Organizing Homepage
- [ ] Add the article you just created to the homepage
- [ ] Add the liveblog you created to the homepage
- [ ] Ensure the homepage updates
- [ ] Click onto each article and verify it displays as expected

## Editing an Article
- [ ] Edit the headline and content of the article you created
- [ ] Ensure it updates

## Unpublishing
- [ ] Unpublish the article
- [ ] Unpublish the liveblog
